road.d: an open way (generally public) for travel or transportation

road agent.d: a holdup man who stops a vehicle and steals from it

road sense.d: good judgment in avoiding trouble or accidents on the road

road test.d: a test to insure that a vehicle is roadworthy

road game.d: a game played away from home

road map.d: a detailed plan or explanation to guide you in setting standards or determining a course of action

road metal.d: broken rock used for repairing or making roads

road surface.d: the paved surface of a paved roadway

roasted.d: cooked by dry heat in an oven

roasting.d: cooking (meat) by dry heat in an oven (usually with fat added)

roadside.d: edge of a way or road or path

roaster.d: a special cooking pan for roasting

road rage.d: violence exhibited by drivers in traffic

road runner.d: someone who participates in long-distance races (especially in marathons)

road builder.d: someone whose business is to build roads

roast beef plant.d: iris with purple flowers and foul-smelling leaves; southern and western Europe and North Africa

road roller.d: vehicle equipped with heavy wide smooth rollers for compacting roads and pavements

roast lamb.d: a cut of lamb suitable for roasting

roast pork.d: cut of pork suitable for roasting

roach holder.d: metal tweezers used by marijuana smokers to hold a roach

road mender.d: a workman who is employed to repair roads

roach clip.d: metal tweezers used by marijuana smokers to hold a roach

roast beef.d: cut of beef suitable for roasting

roar.d: a very loud utterance (like the sound of an animal)

roaring.d: a very loud utterance (like the sound of an animal)

roam.d: move about aimlessly or without any destination, often in search of food or employment

roadkill.d: the dead body of an animal that has been killed on a road by a vehicle

roamer.d: someone who leads a wandering unsettled life

roarer.d: someone who communicates vocally in a very loud voice

roast veal.d: cut of veal suitable for roasting

roadway.d: a road (especially that part of a road) over which vehicles travel

roadblock.d: a barrier set up by police to stop traffic on a street or road in order to catch a fugitive or inspect traffic etc.

roadhouse.d: an inn (usually outside city limits on a main road) providing meals and liquor and dancing and (sometimes) gambling

roadrunner.d: speedy largely terrestrial bird found from California and Mexico to Texas

roadster.d: an open automobile having a front seat and a rumble seat

roan.d: having a brownish coat thickly sprinkled with white or grey

roadman.d: a salesman who travels to call on customers

roadworthiness.d: the quality of being fit to drive on the open road

roadbook.d: a guidebook describing the roads of a country; contains maps and (sometimes) a gazetteer
